title: House of Mystery
overview: Shyam and Manglu , who, finding themselves recently unemployed, take to the streets, masquerading as lame and blind in order to make a few bucks begging from passersby. After being discovered as fakes, and then severely chastised in public, a by-stander offers them a job as caretakers of an old bungalow which is rumored to be haunted and has been all but abandoned by its owner, Sethani, and her beautiful daughter, Prema. Soon they discover the dead body of a former employee and now they are suspected to be hired killers.
